authority: DGFiP — Direction générale des Finances publiques

verified.note: DGFiP's own note, “Règles de vérification de l'algorithme du numéro SPI”, which publishes the numéro fiscal end to end: thirteen characters, C1 restricted to 0-3, and the check “Concaténer C1…C10 ; obtenir le résultat modulo 511 ; vérifier le nombre = Reste”, zero-padded into C11C12C13. That is the mod511 engine, from the authority. SIREN's Luhn is INSEE's at xml.insee.fr/schema/siret.html; the TVA key has no published rule and stays unimplemented.

note.en: The leading digit is 0 to 3 because the cited DGFiP note says so — "C1 doit être égal à 0, 1, 2 ou 3" — and a thirteen-digit string beginning 4 to 9 is therefore malformed rather than merely failing its modulus. The same note's type table omits C7 from its list of numeric characters, which is a slip in the table and not a rule: step 1 of its own algorithm concatenates C1 to C10 into a number, which C7 could not join if it were a letter.
The ninth digit is a Luhn check over the eight before it.

Structure is checked. The two-character key is published as (12 + 3 × (SIREN mod 97)) mod 97, but numbers issued under the older scheme carry a key with letters in it that the same arithmetic does not produce, and a single rule cannot tell the two apart from the number alone. Confirm it against your own document. THE KEY IS LEFT ALPHANUMERIC ON PURPOSE, against the cited DGFiP page, which describes the number as "2 lettres (FR) et 11 chiffres". Keys containing a letter are issued and FRK7552032534 is one of them, sitting in the fixtures below; narrowing this to digits to agree with that sentence would reject real numbers, and rejecting a real number is the worst thing this app does. The page is incomplete, not the format.
Electronic address for e-invoice routing: the EAS scheme code plus your identifier. Carry it now and the card is already correct when a counterparty moves to Peppol.
note.es: Dirección electrónica para el enrutamiento de facturas: el código de esquema EAS más tu identificador. Tenerlo ya deja la tarjeta lista cuando una contraparte pase a Peppol.

note.en: Since September 2026 every business must be able to RECEIVE e-invoices, and large and mid-size firms must issue them. The obligation to issue reaches small and micro businesses in September 2027.
